commuteAccess.summary: S2 has strong start access in Oskarström and weak public-transit access at Gyltige. Oskarström Centrum bus stop is effectively at the start and Oskarström station is about 633 m away. Gyltige has close parking/pickup access, but no regular bus stop was found within 5 km; practical transit exit generally means continuing toward Simlångsdalen/Brearedsskolan.

closestCommutePoints.name: Oskarström Centrum

seasonalLimits: Hallandstrafiken directs users to its planner/app for current stop-specific departures, disruptions and stop maps.
Bus-stop times may be approximate and buses can arrive early; date-specific timetable checks are required.
No useful ferry access exists for either endpoint. Transit lane found Halmstad-Grenaa ferry is not foot-passenger useful and Stena says route closes 2026-04-30.
Gyltige public transit is weak: no regular bus stop found within 5 km. Treat Gyltige as car/pickup access unless continuing to Simlångsdalen.

campingAndFire.summary: The reliable overnight node for S2 is Gyltige, with two official shelters and a fireplace at the endpoint. Virsehatt has reserve facilities but camping is prohibited there. Fire use is limited to designated fireplaces and live fire-ban/fire-risk status; do not encode static fire-allowed status.

fireRules: Use designated fireplaces only and never during fire bans.
During fire bans Hallandsleden says no firewood is placed at campsites.
Virsehatt nature reserve allows fire only at designated place; bring own wood/charcoal.
Keddaböke reserve/boundary context is stricter: rules lane flags no fire inside the reserve.
Halland/Halmstad fire status is dynamic; normal Halmstad assessment period is May-September, and the 2026-04-29 status must not be stored as durable.
toiletsAndWaste: Virsehatt accessible dry toilet is high-confidence official/county facility.
Gyltige dry toilet is supported by Destination Halmstad and OSM but conflicts with adjacent official Hallandsleden stage text; keep pending/access metadata.
Oskarström public toilet location is high-confidence but availability conflicts with a temporary vandalism closure note.
Gyltige waste basket is OSM-only around 209 m from endpoint; do not infer broad waste service along section and pack out unless bin is confirmed.

sourceContradictions.topic: Current S2 boundary versus old Ryet-Gyltige segmentation
sourceContradictions.details: Official Hallandsleden page/API/GPX and Naturkartan title/shape define current Oskarström - Gyltige. OSM relation 7398310, Wikiloc, old field reports, Destination Halmstad naming and Naturkartan slug preserve old Ryet-Gyltige/Gyltige-Ryet framing.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use official GPX/API geo_json and current section identity as canonical; do not start current S2 at Ryet.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden map API geo_json exactly matches official GPX full 411-point route, while nested line.geometry is a 983-point/15.486 km partial line starting 3.386 km east of Oskarström and ending 468.8 m short of Gyltige.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use GPX/API geo_json; suppress line.geometry for current S2.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page/API display 22 km/22000 m, while GPX desc says Total: 21.6 km and computed 2D length is 21.525 km.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use 22 km as official display metadata and store 21.6/21.525 km as GPX/computed evidence.

sourceContradictions.details: Dricksvatten Oskarström says the public toilet/water point is temporarily closed due vandalism, while Toalett Oskarström says a public toilet with water exists by the bus stop.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Do not import as reliable potable water. Mark as closed/unverified or pending until status is checked.

sourceContradictions.details: Destination Halmstad and OSM support Gyltige drinking water and dry toilet, while Hallandsleden does not expose water/toilet category records for Gyltige on S2 and adjacent official section pages say no toilet at Gyltige.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Import shelter/fireplace with high confidence; keep water/toilet as pending/access metadata until verified.

sourceContradictions.topic: Södra delleden overview count and topology
sourceContradictions.details: Södra overview page says six sections/from Gyltige to Koarp, while official API returns nine Södra track segments including Frodeparken - Oskarström, Oskarström - Gyltige and Kvarnforsen - Gyltige. S2 and S3 both terminate at Gyltige in stored geometry directions.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use segment page/API identities and model Gyltige as graph junction; do not infer simple linear order from overview prose.

sourceContradictions.details: Oskarström start has strong bus/rail access, but no regular bus stop was found within 5 km of the Gyltige endpoint. Simlångsdalen/Brearedsskolan require long continuation/walk and adjacent-section highway-crossing caveat.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Mark Gyltige transit as weak; model primary endpoint access as parking/pickup plus continuation-to-Simlångsdalen metadata.

researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: Evidence is strong enough for research-ready S2 without a targeted follow-up batch. Remaining weaknesses are explicit import caveats: Oskarström and Gyltige water/toilet currentness conflicts, weak Gyltige public transit, stale old Ryet-Gyltige geometry/naming, Keddaböke exact boundary interpretation, and dynamic fire/forestry/schedule/currentness checks.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Oskarström - Gyltige, Södra delleden, S2 local/inventory label, official order 18, 22 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Oskarström the route leaves town on paved road, crosses Sennan and climbs into Virsehatt nature reserve before continuing through mixed forest roads, paths, short boardwalks and quiet roads. The section passes Vrenninge grave field, the Virsehatt viewpoint detour, red oak, Stora Ullasjön, Hålväg and Fylleån before reaching the Gyltige shelter/campsite junction.
